protocol.hypothesis: Low-rank regional-severity by physical-vulnerability interactions model damage sensitivity with 48 added coefficients rather than more trees.
protocol.features: Six centered geographic log odds (f90,f109,f141_m10; class3/class1 and class2/others) by eight physical variables; no feature or weight search
protocol.gate: Both seeds delta > 0.001 and paired 95% CI lower > 0
protocol.compute: Two convex classifiers on a shared matrix, no spline or tree fit; stop at weak screening
protocol.history: Sequential research; same outer data have been explored before. No independent blind test or actual Kaggle score.
